settings.title: Strength
settings.text: Built slowly, one session at a time. Nobody hands it to you.

settings.title: Discipline
settings.text: Showing up on the days you don’t feel like it. Those days count the most.

settings.title: Faith
settings.text: The reason behind the work. It’s printed on our shirts because it’s part of why we train.

settings.title: Perseverance
settings.text: Falling short, then coming back for it. Every lifter knows the feeling.
